properties.name: Roosevelt GC footprint (v4 — full course after Google Maps cross-check)
properties.source: Google Maps visual inspection + NAIP confirmation. Course bounded by Commonwealth Canyon Dr (north + east), Vermont Canyon Dr (west), Lovell House (south).
revision_history: v1 (Phase A research): 1.52 km² centered on bad centroid 34.1265, -118.2967 — placed ~220m north of course in Griffith Park hills. WRONG.
v2 (bbox correction): 0.71 km² with verified Wikipedia centroid + buffer. Contained course but also Greek Theatre parking and Los Feliz residential.
v3: 0.42 km² tight to course features visible in NAIP. Matched LAZ southern edge at 34.118 BUT cut off the entire eastern half of the course.
v4 (this file): ~1.17 km². Extends east to ~-118.283 (Commonwealth Canyon Dr east flank) and slightly south to 34.117. Captures full course per Google Maps cross-check.
properties.laz_coverage_note: South edge at 34.117 is 100m below LAZ coverage (LAZ bottom is 34.118). East edge at -118.283 is within the eastern LAZ column (-118.290 to -118.280) — fully covered. If the 100m south gap matters, we can pull 3 more LAZ tiles from the 037500 row.
